spell.whimsical_spells.flower_field.guid: Covers the ground around you with wildflowers. Rarely, a sunflower blooms.
spell.whimsical_spells.repair_item.guide: Spends your base mana to repair the damaged item in your hand. Cast while crouching to repair your worn armor instead, with lower efficiency. Repeated use on the same piece repairs less. Level 1: 20% hand / 12% armor. Level 5: 50% hand / 35% armor.
spell.whimsical_spells.magic_trace.guide: Senses the magical power of nearby structures and leaves a particle trail pointing to the closest one: strongholds, villages, woodland mansions and more. Does not detect jungle temples, pyramids or ancient cities. Higher level, longer range.
spell.whimsical_spells.jubelade.guide: Turns flower petals into steel and fires them in a straight line. Damages everything they pass through and stops at the first block. Higher level, longer range and damage.
spell.whimsical_spells.medrozobalt.guide: Turns your attack into a whirlwind that pushes and damages enemies around you. Higher level, larger radius and stronger push.
Hides your magical presence: hostile mobs detect you from much less distance for a while. Higher level, longer duration and better stealth.
spell.whimsical_spells.reamstroha.guide: Gathers the surrounding water into a huge sphere above the target and lets it fall as a cascade, soaking them: damage, slowness, and it puts out fire. Stronger when it rains or there is water nearby. Cast while crouching to drop the cascade on yourself and your allies: it puts out fire and grants resistance.
spell.whimsical_spells.meehkeit.guide: Detects nearby trapped chests, even hidden ones, and marks them with blue flame columns for a few seconds. Higher level, larger radius.
ui.whimsical_spells.repair_no_item: You need a damaged item in your hand
ui.whimsical_spells.repair_no_armor: None of your armor pieces are damaged
ui.whimsical_spells.trace_found: You sense a trace of magical power...
ui.whimsical_spells.trace_none: You sense no trace of magical power nearby
ui.whimsical_spells.trace_here: The magical power is right here
ui.whimsical_spells.meehkeit_none: You sense no trapped chests nearby
ui.whimsical_spells.meehkeit_found: Trapped chests nearby: %s. The closest is %s blocks to the %s
spell.whimsical_spells.reelseiden.guide: A straight slash that cuts almost anything: it opens a slit through blocks up to the hardness of stone and kills any mob or player it reaches in one hit. It stops at harder blocks such as deepslate, ores or obsidian. Higher level, longer range.
